macros.name: dayofweekname
macros.doc: prints the day of week for the specified date.

macros.name: ddmmyydate
macros.doc: This declaration will redefine \today to produce the current date displayed in the form 08/03/00.

macros.name: ddmmyyyydate
macros.doc: This declaration will redefine \today to produce the current date displayed in the form 08/03/2000.

macros.name: dmyydate
macros.doc: This declaration will redefine \today to produce the current date displayed in the form 8/3/00.

macros.name: dmyyyydate
macros.doc: This declaration will redefine \today to produce the current date displayed in the form 8/3/2000.

macros.name: longdate
macros.doc: This declaration will redefine \today to produce the current date displayed in the form Wednesday 8th March, 2000 if the package option dayofweek is used, or 8th March, 2000 if the package option nodayofweek is used.

macros.name: mdyydate
macros.doc: This declaration will redefine \today to produce the current date displayed in the form 3/8/00.

macros.name: mdyyyydate
macros.doc: This declaration will redefine \today to produce the current date displayed in the form 3/8/2000.

macros.name: mmddyydate
macros.doc: This declaration will redefine \today to produce the current date displayed in the form 03/08/00.

macros.name: mmddyyyydate
macros.doc: This declaration will redefine \today to produce the current date displayed in the form 03/08/2000.

macros.name: monthname
macros.doc: The commands \monthname and \shortmonthname, will produce the month name in the current language.

macros.name: monthname
macros.doc: The commands \monthname and \shortmonthname, will produce the month name in the current language.

macros.name: pdfdate
macros.doc: prints the date in the format required for PDF files, e.g. if the date is 1 May 2004 and time is 22:02, \pdfdate will print 20040501220200.

macros.name: shortdayofweekname
macros.doc: prints the abbreviated name for the day of week for the specified date.

macros.name: shortmonthname
macros.doc: prints the abbreviated month name, e.g. Aug.

macros.name: shortmonthname
macros.doc: prints the abbreviated month name, e.g. Aug.

macros.name: usdate
macros.doc: This declaration will redefine \today to produce the current date displayed in the form March 8, 2000.

macros.name: yyyymmdddate
macros.doc: This declaration will redefine \today to produce the current date displayed in the form 2000/03/08.
